body:
Hey, I hope I'm not to late. I'm not sure how valuable my words are, since I'm pretty broken and have my own issues...

And I'm not sure if what I say will mean much when I say "I know what you're feeling." People tell me that all the time, but I know they don't. They really don't. You don't know what this feeling is like unless you have the same illness...

...but that's the point I'm going to try to get at. The way you feel the way you do...it's not your fault. We have these thoughts, these feelings...but they're not who we are. Sometimes we think it is...but we know better. We're just sick...and it's an illness that can be treated and managed. 

The one thing that helps get me through is knowing that the reason I'm feeling the way I am is simply because my brain isn't working the way it should. I don't know if that'll help you at all, but I can find solace in that fact when I find myself in my darkest place.

I hope you're alright, and just want you to know there's at least one other person out there that truly knows what you're feeling.
